title: EasyEnchant YS
description: A developer utility datapack that lets you apply any enchantment at any level to your held item for fast Minecraft testing.
body:
# EasyEnchant YS

**EasyEnchant** is a Minecraft Java datapack developer utility by **ManaMage**, released under **Yazsras Studios**.

It lets you quickly apply any valid enchantment at any level to the item in your main hand. This is mainly built for datapack creators, map makers, creative testing worlds, and controlled servers where fast item testing matters.

## Main Command

`/function enh:items/apply {id:"minecraft:fire_aspect",level:50}`

Hold an item, run the command, and EasyEnchant applies the enchantment directly to that item.

## What It Helps With

- Testing custom weapons and tools
- Testing enchantment scaling
- Testing datapack items
- Testing Minecraft item-component behavior
- Avoiding long custom `/give` commands
- Bypassing vanilla `/enchant` restrictions for development use

## Included Commands

- `/function enh:items/apply {id:"minecraft:fire_aspect",level:50}`
- `/function enh:info/help`
- `/function enh:info/index`
- `/function enh:systems/info`
- `/function enh:systems/install`
- `/function enh:systems/repair`
- `/function enh:systems/refresh`
- `/function enh:systems/uninstall`

## Warning

EasyEnchant can create extremely overpowered or unusual test items. High-level enchantments can cause extreme behavior, such as Wind Burst 255 launching players thousands of blocks upward.

Use this in creative worlds, development worlds, or controlled servers. Back up important worlds before experimenting.
